description: 津波避難施設・津波避難場所一覧データ [evacuation shelters and public facilities and tsunami] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 沖縄市. 沖縄市の津波避難施設・津波避難場所一覧データです。. Coverage: 沖縄市. The portal files it under the publisher 沖縄市. Its tags are 位置情報, 津波避難施設, 災害. It offers 5 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-03-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
